scope: Generic G-code export layer planning for all devices; Windows Release native verification. No machine/profile identity selects the fix.
root_causes: The old up-front count duplicated Z merging with a different rule from collect_layers_to_print; it also included empty object/support planes.
An empty object plane could emit a layer-change tag without a move, while preview renumbers only existing move vertices.
After empty planes are omitted, a source Layer::id is not an index into the emitted layer plan; spiral finishing must recognize the last emitted item.
changes: Build and filter the canonical layer plan before expanding total_layer_count; reuse that same plan for generation.
Sequential instances reuse their cached per-object plan, and each instance contributes the actual emitted count.
Retain genuine object/support paths, belt brim/apron paths, tower-only layers and explicit user events; discard records without a tool or printable content.
Keep original first-layer validation, physical print_z, toolpath generation, profile parameters and support-contact planning unchanged.
Count serially processed output records to detect the final spiral-vase layer, excluding pipeline no-op sentinels.

regressions.empty_plane_print_sequences: 3 nozzle sizes x 2 print sequences x 2 instances = 6 parameter combinations
regressions.thin_bed_support: 3 nozzle sizes x 2 independent-body modes x 2 print sequences = 12 parameter combinations
regressions.spiral_finishing: Both print sequences retain constant-Z finishing extrusion at the final physical layer after an omitted empty plane.

path_comparisons.label: x2
path_comparisons.normalization: Merge only consecutive collinear, same-direction G1 depositions with identical feedrate, feature, width, height and tool and proportional E within one 0.00001 mm exported E quantum; sum E exactly to 8 decimal places. This ignores fan insertion split points, not geometry or material changes.

path_comparisons.label: vulcan600
path_comparisons.normalization: Merge only consecutive collinear, same-direction G1 depositions with identical feedrate, feature, width, height and tool and proportional E within one 0.00001 mm exported E quantum; sum E exactly to 8 decimal places. This ignores fan insertion split points, not geometry or material changes.

serialization_difference: Vulcan600 has 764012 rather than 764013 positive XY/E commands because an obsolete empty-layer fan transition no longer splits one collinear line. After same-direction/collinearity and proportional-E normalization, ordered geometry, total E, arc IJ, commanded speed, role, width, height and tool are identical. X2 raw deposition commands were also identical. Cooling parameters are unchanged; raw G-code/fan timing is not claimed byte-identical.
limits: Native G-code and processor-result verification is not a live GUI or physical printer qualification.
X2 retains two legitimate independent object/support records at the same serialized Z108.6; every emitted record deposits material.
Legacy BBL preset compatibility lookup messages remain in CLI logs; this fix does not claim warning-free slicing.
The initially corrected mutable test-fixture accessor, expected old-algorithm failures and raw split-sensitive comparison are retained as diagnostic receipts.
No install, commit or push was requested or performed by this fix task.
